name: tool-advisor
report_sanitization: Published JSON retains findings, coverage and static-only metadata. Workspace/staging absolute paths are replaced by relative labels; unused LLM provider/configuration provenance is omitted. Report hashes refer to these sanitized copies.

scan_scope.coverage: All 6 advisor files, all 3 staged grilling files including MIT license, and both find-skills files fully covered; no exclusions or suppressions.
scan_scope.runtime_execution: Scanner CLI executed from its verified pinned package. Candidate skills/scripts were not invoked by the scanner.
scan_scope.network: --no-llm disables model analysis; it is not network isolation. Package vulnerability analyzers can query vulnerability services. The advisor ledger itself has no network calls or subprocesses.

manual_review.skill_and_references: Complete instructions, all three references, discovery metadata and full ledger implementation read. Interview and discovery are actual named dependencies, with native invocation/manual loading distinguished and a disclosed pre-confirmation fact-lookup adaptation.
manual_review.ledger: Stdlib only; explicit project/input paths; regular-file and symlink checks, size bound, strict JSON, ignored private state, exclusive write lock, atomic state replacement and stale-snapshot rejection. Confirms current brief/proposal, checks role readiness, task DAG and acceptance evidence. Does not authenticate user answers or verify output truth.
manual_review.installer: Full source reviewed by the primary agent, with regression tests. Complete payload hashes, source audits and known historical exceptions checked before activation; scanner source provenance/version verified; stages all payloads and validates complete static reports; preserves local edits and rolls back failed activation. Receipt records file checks without claiming native invocation.
manual_review.independent_review: Independent ledger reviewer reported permissive preexisting ignore rules, FIFO input hangs, and inconsistent complete-state acceptance. All three were reproduced and corrected with regression coverage. Installer review was by the primary agent; no independent whole-release approval is claimed.
manual_review.dependencies: Python stdlib for installer/ledger. Scanner separately bootstrapped into an isolated development venv at the reviewed Git revision using saved constraints; dependency compatibility check passed. Its Hatchling build dependency is not pinned by the runtime constraints.
manual_review.license: Existing upstream payloads unchanged. Grilling installation includes its exact reviewed parent MIT license; find-skills retains its saved MIT license.
manual_review.host_permissions: Tool-scope metadata is host-dependent. allowed-tools is experimental preapproval in the Agent Skills specification, not an enforceable generic sandbox. No unsupported permissions claim was added to remove LP3.

historical_exceptions.result: Fresh complete staged scan has exactly the existing EA2 finding; saved source hashes and parent license match.
Fresh complete scan has exactly the 12 existing RP1 findings. Original explicit approval and identical payload hashes checked through the retained restore audit.

unit_tests.scope: Real temporary filesystem/CLI ledger and setup tests; installer scan outputs controlled in tests to exercise success, rollback and refusal branches.

verification.real_report_validation: Final actual scanner reports validated against complete manifest payloads. Historical exceptions accepted exactly; advisor LP3 rejected with an empty approval list.
verification.successful_production_bundle_install: Actual release payload installed in an isolated profile. User-global or laptop installation was not performed.
verification.native_host_invocation: No model task was executed; discovery is verified separately from actual interviewing/discovery workflow invocation.
verification.preapproval_activation_check: Actual setup CLI refused the source bundle with blocked-new-finding before creating the isolated target profile or skill root. See verification.json.
verification.actual_activation: Real source bundle installed after fresh complete static scans into an isolated cloud profile; --check-advisor returned ready. See verification.json.
verification.approval_regressions: Five new tests cover approved installation, changed payloads, new findings, altered historical report, missing approval and incomplete source review. The first run failed before support was implemented; final suite passes.
verification.native_host_discovery: Codex CLI 0.159.2 fresh app-server skills/list discovered all three installed skills enabled, with no target errors, under an isolated project .agents/skills root. See native-discovery.json.
verification.installed_ledger: Installed ledger initialized and resumed state successfully in an isolated project.

limitations: Static coverage is not a security guarantee.
Response trials are not statistical quality benchmarks or native host invocation.
Routing relies on the host reading instructions; the ledger cannot force compliance.
Published source is not activation approval.

approved_finding.finding: Skill declares no tool scope ('permissions' or 'allowed-tools') but code capabilities were detected: file_write.
approved_finding.explanation: The reviewed stdlib ledger writes project-local state, an ignore file, a lock and atomic temporary state files. The skill has no allowed-tools preapproval. Normal host execution permissions remain applicable; adding broad preapproval would not establish a filesystem sandbox.
approved_finding.requested_exception_scope: Only LP3 for tool-advisor 1.0.0 at the six hashes above. No new tool preapproval, general scanner bypass, approval of future hashes or evidence of laptop installation.
